assets.name: proof_card_back
assets.generation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: game sprite proof for a terminal arcade asset pipeline
Primary request: create one original face-down playing card back for glyphcade, suitable as the first proof asset for a future Klondike game
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background outside the card silhouette
Subject: one centered portrait playing card seen straight-on, with a clear rounded rectangular silhouette and a symmetric geometric card-back pattern
Style/medium: crisp retro arcade pixel-art-inspired illustration with flat, clean shapes and a restrained high-contrast palette
Composition/framing: 2:3 portrait card, centered, fully visible, even transparent margin on all sides, no perspective tilt
Color palette: deep navy background with cyan and violet geometric accents, consistent with a dark terminal arcade
Constraints: transparent pixels outside the card; opaque card interior; strong silhouette and readable pattern when reduced; no text, letters, numbers, ranks, suits, logos, trademarks, watermark, drop shadow, hands, table, scenery, or extra objects
Avoid: photorealism, paper texture, gradients that muddy small-size rendering, decorative text, cropped edges
edit_prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: game sprite proof for a terminal arcade asset pipeline
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target
Primary request: preserve the card-back design, geometry, pixel-art pattern, colors, proportions, and straight-on framing; change only the alpha treatment
Constraints: make every pixel outside the card silhouette genuinely fully transparent (alpha 0); remove the exterior blue glow and all drop shadow; make the complete card silhouette and interior fully opaque (alpha 255), including its cyan border; keep a clean hard edge suitable for sprite compositing; retain even transparent margin; no text, logos, watermark, scenery, or extra objects
Avoid: translucent card interior, semitransparent haze outside the card, glow, shadow, altered pattern, altered palette, cropped edges

Use case: background-extraction
Asset type: game sprite proof for a terminal arcade asset pipeline
Input images: Image 1 is the card-back edit target
Primary request: extract the single playing card as a clean cutout on a genuinely transparent background
Constraints: preserve the card design, pattern, palette, dimensions, proportions, and straight-on framing exactly; make outside pixels actual PNG alpha transparency, not a visible checkerboard; remove the white/gray checkerboard and any background pixels completely; keep the card itself opaque with a clean hard silhouette; preserve transparent margin; no glow, no drop shadow, no text, no logos, no watermark, no new objects
Avoid: baked checkerboard pattern, white background, gray background, RGB-only output, translucent card interior, changed artwork, cropped edges

assets.name: solitaire_neon_atlas
assets.generation_prompt: Run the committed authoring tool over the Neon face source and proof card back. Add exact corner ranks and ASCII suit identifiers, deterministic vector suit pips, and face-card marks; pack Clubs, Diamonds, Hearts, Spades by row and A through K by column, with the back in row five. Preserve alpha and emit 128x192 sprites in one 1664x960 PNG.
